method: Author self-score from bellows-golem.fidelity-compare.jpg: orthographic EEVEE renders (AgX, the fixed shared light rig, not tuned to the score) of the low-poly model at the concept sheet's front, side and back angles, framed at the sheet's own scale (2.1 m over 806 sheet pixels), judged side by side against the sheet crops, plus the six in-engine shots in staging/engine (three.js 0.186.1, headless Chromium on ANGLE Metal, Apple M4, with the runtime D11 glow look; glow-close is the seat camera narrowed to the upper body). This pass followed the independent review (59/100): collar sleeve and band with a taller forward capsule head and two glowing eyes, the barrel top band cut to a back arc, round front and back grilles with five glowing slots, layered pauldron drums with emerald bosses, one continuous stave barrel over rounded walnut pleats, an arched back strap, armoured thighs and greaves, rounded mitt fists, per-loop painted walnut value, brass normal scale 0.15, and the head and shoulder pivots moved onto the collar and drum axes so the head and drums turn in place. Engine colour medians (idle shot, the spec's boxes and masks): upper-body brass sRGB (119, 93, 55), hue 36, S 0.54, V 0.47 (concept 154, 111, 57); barrel walnut (83, 55, 36), V 0.33 (concept 68, 42, 27); front grille glow (236, 186, 89); eyes (243, 178, 70); glow-close grille (247, 195, 74). Vent: the chimney flame plume on the sheet is not modeled. p5-automatons-design.md models the vent as an emissive chimney mouth only and the art bible rules out smoke, so each mouth carries a glowing ember dome instead; this is a design-note deviation, not a fidelity gap.
gaps: The head sits lower in the collar than the sheet's, so from the front the capsule shows less above the barrel top and the bezel reads larger relative to the head.
The fists are rounded mitts with a finger roll and pad rows; the sheet's fists are clenched, with distinct knuckles and a thumb wrapped across the front.
The arms hang close to vertical from the side; the sheet angles the forearms forward more strongly, with the fists ahead of the knees.
The legs remain slimmer than the sheet's, and the knees lack the sheet's large round joint with an emerald seen from the front.
The brass is about 20% darker and less saturated than the sheet's in the engine (median V 0.47 against 0.60), and the walnut is about 20% lighter than the sheet's.
The walnut and brass are factor-only or the shared tileable set: no plank grain, wear or engraving as painted on the sheet.
In the EEVEE compare renders the grilles read pale because the D11 glow ramp is runtime-only; the engine shots show the intended amber core.
